dashboardDescription: Review and export your health information.
title: Personal health summary
intro: Create a private summary of the information saved in your account. Choose a period and the sections to include.
periodHelp: Questionnaire submissions on both selected dates are included. Your current profile reflects the information saved today.
invalidPeriod: Choose a valid range: the start date must be on or before the end date.
loadError: The summary could not be loaded. Please try again.
privacyBody: This page is available only after health consent is verified. Questionnaire records and authenticated Framingham results are stored in the app database. A summary is generated on request and is not stored separately. Self-service retention or deletion controls are not currently available. Downloaded files are saved to your device.
consentNote: Downloading or sharing happens only when you choose an action. The app does not send the summary to anyone automatically.
name: Name
emptyHistory: No questionnaire submissions were found in this date range.
disclaimer: This summary is for informational purposes only. It is not a diagnosis and does not replace advice from a healthcare professional.
shareUnsupported: File sharing is not available in this browser. You can download the JSON and share it yourself.
shareError: The file could not be shared. You can download it instead.
